phase_2d_this_dispatch.summary: canonical_f1 (up-confluence, BFrame.f1) and canonical_f2 (down-confluence, BFrame.f2) proved sorry-free, completing CanonicalModel.lean. canonical_f2 reuses box_witness_pair_underivable + modal_set_exclusion directly as black boxes (u := v', already given via canonicalR w v's box clause + v <= v', no fresh prime-extension construction needed). canonical_f1 generalizes diamond_witness_underivable from a singleton seed {phi} to the full prime theory v.val as seed, via a new private lemma canonical_f1_underivable: the finitely many v.val-drawn hypotheses are packed into bigAnd Lv (reusing unpack_conj_partial from 2b-sublemma) so canonicalR w v's diamond clause applies to this single conjunction formula, sidestepping the invalid 'conjunction of diamonds implies diamond of conjunction' direction. A new generic private helper extract_split_union (2-way list partition by pointwise P/Q disjunction) supports the split.
deliverables: extract_split_union (private, generic 2-way list partition, analogue of extract_split/extract_split_dia)
canonical_f1_underivable (private, up-confluence DerivExcludes precondition, generalizes diamond_witness_underivable to a general prime-theory seed)
canonical_f2 (public, down-confluence, matches BFrame.f2 exactly, reuses box_witness_pair_underivable + modal_set_exclusion directly)
